$m00d%2Ryoma%0$s13: Damn! I let my guard down! Looks like there's someone out here with a bit of backbone!
$f63f%2Hayato%0$s13: I-I got out... hee hee hee. Ph-phew, I'm saved...
$m02b%2Musashi%0$s13: Good ol' Musashi's built tough and built to last, so I'm still alive and kickin', see?! Wahahaha...
$m03a%2Benkei%0$s13: Man, I'm real sorry. Everybody, you'll have to fight hard enough to cover for me too...
$m04d%2Go%0$s13: Gaaah! Getting taken out in a place like this?! You've gotta be kidding me!
$m05b%2Sho%0$s13: I've been hit. It's galling, but I'm returning to base.
$m06a%2Gai%0$s13: Daaamn! Just you wait! I'll be back on the front line in no time!
$m07a%2Michiru%0$s13: I made it out safely. ...I'm sorry. I'm leaving the rest to you!
$m08a%2Lambert%0$s13: Hmm... It seems I'm just an old has-been after all... Returning to base.
$m09d%2Schwartz%0$s13: Raaaaagh! You'll pay for this! It'll take more than this to beat America!
$m12b%2Linda%0$s13: How could this happen?! For me, of all people, to be shot down...
$m13d%2Shatner%0$s13: Ugh! I almost had that one won... Returning to base now.
$f14f%2Jack%0$s13: Oh! No! Sometimes these things happen-desu!
$f15f%2Mary%0$s13: Oh! My God! Real combat sure is tough, isn't it, Brother!
$m16d%2Akane%0$s13: Sorry! I got hit. Daaamn it!!
$m17d%2Tsubaki%0$s13: Ngh... Next time, you won't get off so easy!
$m61b%2$n%0$s13: Damn, they got me! I'm counting on you guys for the rest!
$m62a%2$n%0$s13: I did all I could! I'm leaving the rest to you. Returning to base.
$m21a%2Dr. Saotome%0$s13: Wh-what a disaster! To think this Getter could be beaten! It seems the enemy was stronger than I thought...
$f25a%2Researcher%0$s13: I made it out safely, but... I'm sorry! I've gone and wrecked the precious Getter Robo G...
$f26a%2Researcher%0$s13: I thought I could handle it... Piloting a Getter really is hard, after all...
$m00b%2Ryoma%0$s13: Damn it! The Getter won't listen to me!
$f63b%2Hayato%0$s13: S-something's wrong...?! I-is it broken?! Waaaaaah!

$m04b%2Go%0$s13: Damn you! Move like you're supposed to!
$m05b%2Sho%0$s13: It's no use! The Getter won't respond to the controls!
$m06b%2Gai%0$s13: Th-the robot's Getter Ray level won't stabilize!
$m08b%2Lambert%0$s13: Blast it! The Getter won't obey me!
$m09b%2Schwartz%0$s13: Damn it! This is why you can't trust anything made in Japan!
$m10b%2Bob%0$s13: Wh-what the--! This thing's moving on its own!
$m11b%2Sam%0$s13: Come on! Move the way I tell you, damn it!
$m12b%2Linda%0$s13: What?! You won't do as I say?!
$m13d%2Shatner%0$s13: Wh-what?! Something's wrong with this Getter!
$f14f%2Jack%0$s13: WHAT?! The Getter is moving all by itself-desu!
$m16b%2Akane%0$s13: What's going on?! The Getter's moving on its own?!
$m17b%2Tsubaki%0$s13: The Getter's gone berserk?! What does this mean?!
$m61b%2$n%0$s13: Th-the Getter... is it going berserk?!
$m21d%2Dr. Saotome%0$s13: This is bad! The Getter Rays are running wild! I can't control the Getter!
$f25b%2Researcher%0$s13: Th-this is bad! It's gone berserk!
